summary: Held through normal chop (-6 to -13pts, giveback 17-27%) while the 1m lambda stayed strongly positive and closes kept probing back toward highs -- looked like a routine pullback within the prior strong upmove. At t=6m price cratered from -8 to -28 on a single -30.5pt 1m bar, the leg-age counter reset to 0 (signaling the up-leg had structurally ended), z_21 flipped hard negative, and three independent against-indicators (KMDR, HA, PROPP) fired together -- that convergence of a sharp break + leg reset + multi-signal agreement is what triggered the bail. Next time: watch for the leg-age reset as the key tell that a pullback has become a structural break, not just magnitude of the drawdown alone.
